name: FallBall
author: unity_PC_crMbSNWyC-Q
description: 操作方法はマウスを左右に動かすだけです。上から徐々に速度が速くなって降りてくる針に触れないように落下してスコアを稼ぐゲームです。数年前に数時間で開発したゲームです。All you have to do is move the mouse left and right. The game is played by moving the mouse left and right. The goal is to score points by falling from the top of the screen without touching the needles that are gradually coming down with increasing speed.  I developed this game a few years ago in a few hours.　プレイ画面右下の音量ボタンの隣のスクリーンショットボタンでハイスコアの画像を載せられます。You can post a picture of your high score by clicking the screenshot button next to the volume button at the bottom right of the play screen.
